entries.prompt: Hero product studio shot of VOLT-KENTE X1 limited-edition matte-black wireless studio headphones resting on a dark basalt stone slab. Subtle woven gold-and-emerald geometric accents along the headband only. Moody emerald and gold rim lighting, crisp metallic reflections on the ear-cup hardware, deep shadows, high-contrast dark-mode studio commercial, centered vertical 9:16 composition, product fully in frame, no text, no logos.
entries.notes: Rendered at quality=medium (not high) via free-trial unlimited allowance; user approved 'APPROVE A'. Paid-equivalent: 1 credit. Balance verified 10 -> 10.

entries.prompt: Smooth orbital push-in around the headphones on the basalt slab: camera arcs slowly clockwise while pushing closer. Subtle acoustic dust particles shimmer in the emerald and gold rim light. Keep the headphone design, woven headband pattern and stone slab identical to the reference frame. No text.
